info.cls_name: 世界格局與歷史地理視野
info.cls_ename: World platforms and perspectives of history & geography

subTitleDesc.sub_title: 人物抉擇與歷史變遷的關聯
subTitleDesc.sub_describe: 本課程以歷史人物的生命經驗為出發點，探討人在不同時代情境下如何面對抉擇、權力、責任與道德困境。透過對人物決策過程與結果的分析，學生將思考「身為人」在現實限制中如何堅持信念、回應環境，並反省自身價值觀與人生態度，從而達成人格與思辨能力的成長。

description.describe_ch:
「歷史」其實是與「現代」生活息息相關之事物，並非是過去、不可接觸的事物，更非只是課本中用來死背的文字而已。
本課程將以中國歷史人物為主軸，透過這些人物之生命歷程與評價，帶領同學們認識什麼是「歷史」，以及說明這些人物如何面對他們人生中的問題，建立學生之多元價值，再協助同學自身面對、解決未來可能遭遇之問題，從而體會到歷史對於人生之意義。
description.describe_eh: History is not something in the remote past, but within our daily life. This course focuses on figures in Chinese History. Students will see how these people handle their lives and also evaluate their life in a way to improve students’ own life. With this course students are expected to learn the concept to respect the value of diversity. Also, students can avoid falling into any similar mistakes that these figures made in history and that is the reason why humans need to learn history.

targets.describe_ch: 了解何謂「歷史」，思考歷史與今日的關係。
targets.describe_en: To understand what is history, and the relationship between history and today

targets.describe_ch: 分析歷史人物的成敗得失並應用到學生自身。
targets.describe_en: To analyze the success and failures of historical figures and apply them to our own lives.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
本課程以建立良好學習環境為目標，期望師生之間以及同學彼此，皆以尊重、理性與專業的方式進行互動。課堂鼓勵多元觀點與討論，但須在彼此尊重的前提下進行。

一、基本課堂行為

請準時出席並做好上課準備，避免遲到或提早離開影響課程進行。
上課期間請避免聊天、使用手機或從事與課程無關之活動，以免干擾他人學習。
當同學發言或進行報告時，應專心聆聽並給予基本尊重。
鼓勵參與討論並表達不同觀點，但應以理性、適當的方式進行。

二、課堂設備與使用規範

筆記型電腦或平板僅限於課程相關用途（如記錄筆記、查閱資料）。
行動裝置請設定為靜音，避免來電或通知影響課堂。

三、分組與互動原則

分組活動中應積極參與，並尊重組員意見。
討論與交流應以促進理解為目的，避免干擾其他同學學習。

四、課程溝通與基本禮儀

與教師或同學聯繫時，應使用適當語氣並清楚表達內容。
課程相關資訊將透過學校系統公告，請同學定期查閱並掌握最新訊息。

五、學生學習責任

學生應主動掌握課程進度，並妥善安排學習時間。
請依規定完成期中「形成性教學評估」及期末「學生意見調查」，以協助課程改進。

本規則之目的在於維持良好學習環境，而非限制學生表達。只要不影響他人學習並保持基本尊重，課堂將保持彈性與開放。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
This course aims to foster a positive learning environment. Students and the instructor are expected to interact with one another in a respectful, rational, and professional manner. Diverse perspectives and open discussion are encouraged, provided that mutual respect is maintained.

1. Basic Classroom Behavior
Students are expected to attend class on time and be prepared. Late arrival or early departure should be avoided as it may disrupt the class.
During class, students should refrain from chatting, using mobile phones, or engaging in activities unrelated to the course, so as not to disrupt others’ learning.
When others are speaking or presenting, students should listen attentively and show respect.
Participation in discussion and the expression of different viewpoints are encouraged, but should be conducted in a respectful and appropriate manner.
2. Use of Devices
Laptops and tablets may be used for course-related purposes only (e.g., note-taking, accessing materials).
Mobile devices should be set to silent mode to avoid interruptions during class.
3. Group Work and Interaction
Students are expected to participate actively in group activities and respect the opinions of group members.
Discussions should aim to enhance understanding and should not interfere with other students’ learning.
4. Communication and Etiquette
When communicating with the instructor or classmates, students should use appropriate language and express themselves clearly.
Course-related information will be announced through the university system; students are responsible for checking updates regularly.
5. Student Responsibilities
Students are expected to keep up with the course schedule and manage their learning time effectively.
Students should complete the midterm formative evaluation and the end-of-semester course survey as required, as these are important for course improvement.

The purpose of these guidelines is to maintain an effective learning environment rather than to restrict expression. As long as students respect others and do not disrupt the class, the learning environment will remain flexible and open.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
多元與包容
本課程致力於營造多元、包容與尊重的學習環境。歡迎同學在課堂中適時表達個人觀點，並以理性與尊重的態度面對不同意見。不同背景與想法，將有助於深化我們對課程內容的理解。如有任何疑慮，歡迎與我討論。

學習方式與建議
本課程重視對內容的理解與整理，而非單純記憶。建議同學在課後適度回顧課堂內容，並透過學習單將所學轉化為自己的表達。與其追求標準答案，更重要的是建立清楚且有邏輯的理解與說明能力。適當閱讀相關資料並進行整理與反思，將有助於提升學習成效。

課程溝通方式
如對課程內容或作業有疑問，請以電子郵件與我聯繫。來信時請清楚說明問題內容，以利回覆與討論。我將於合理時間內回覆課程相關問題，並視需要提供進一步說明。

學習支持
我重視每位同學的學習進展。若在學習過程中遇到困難，建議及早與我聯繫，我將協助釐清問題或提供適當建議，以支持您完成本課程的學習。

本課程期待在良好溝通與互相尊重的基礎上，建立穩定而有效的學習節奏。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Diversity and Inclusion

This course is committed to fostering a learning environment that values diversity, inclusion, and mutual respect. Students are encouraged to express their perspectives appropriately in class and to engage with differing viewpoints in a rational and respectful manner. Diverse backgrounds and ideas contribute to a deeper understanding of the course content. If you have any concerns, you are welcome to discuss them with the instructor.

Learning Approach and Suggestions

This course emphasizes understanding and organization of knowledge rather than rote memorization. Students are encouraged to review course materials after class and to use worksheets to transform what they have learned into their own expressions. Rather than seeking standard answers, the goal is to develop clear and logically structured understanding and explanation. Reading relevant materials and engaging in reflection will further enhance learning outcomes.

Course Communication

If you have questions regarding course content or assignments, please contact the instructor via email. When writing, clearly describe your questions to facilitate effective communication. The instructor will respond within a reasonable timeframe and provide further clarification when necessary.

Learning Support

The instructor values each student’s learning progress. If you encounter difficulties during the course, you are encouraged to reach out early. The instructor will assist in clarifying issues and provide appropriate guidance to support your learning.

This course aims to establish a steady and effective learning rhythm through clear communication and mutual respect.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
本課程重視學生對知識的理解與個人表達，並強調在學習過程中建立誠信與責任意識。
本課程之評量包含每月學習單（個人作業）與分組報告（含簡報製作），相關學術誠信原則如下：
一、個人學習單（個別完成）
  1. 學習單須由學生自行完成，並以自身語言整理與表達學習內容。
  2. 可參考課堂內容、書籍、網路資料或生成式AI工具，但不得直接複製貼上或僅做表面修改。
  3. 使用外部資料（含AI生成內容）時，應適當標示來源。
  4. 學生須能說明其作答內容之理解與思考過程。
二、分組報告（合作完成）
  1. 分組報告與簡報（PPT）可由組員共同討論與製作，鼓勵分工合作。
  2. 簡報內容可參考外部資料，但須標示來源，不得直接挪用未經處理之內容。
  3. 各組成員應參與報告內容之理解與準備，並能回應相關提問。
  4. 若有明確分工（如資料整理、簡報設計等），建議於報告中簡要說明。
三、共同原則
  1. 鼓勵同學之間進行討論，但所有個人繳交之作業須獨立完成。
  2. 不得將他人作品（含同學、網路資料或AI生成內容）直接作為本人作品提交。
  3. 所有提交內容均視為學生本人之學習成果，並須對其內容負責。
違反學術誠信原則者，該次作業將視情況不予計分；情節重大或屢犯者，將依學校相關規定處理。
如在學習過程中遇到困難，建議主動與教師聯繫，以尋求協助與適當的學習支持。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
This course emphasizes students’ understanding of knowledge and their ability to express ideas independently. It also highlights the importance of integrity and responsibility throughout the learning process.
Assessment in this course includes monthly worksheets (individual assignments) and group presentations (including presentation slides). The following principles of academic integrity apply:
1. Individual Worksheets (to be completed independently)
  1. Worksheets must be completed by students independently and presented in their own words.
  2. Students may consult course materials, books, online resources, or generative AI tools; however, direct copying or superficial modification is not permitted.
  3. When using external sources (including AI-generated content), proper citation must be provided.
  4. Students should be able to explain their understanding and reasoning behind their responses.
2. Group Presentations (collaborative work)
  1. Group presentations and slides (PPT) may be prepared collaboratively, and division of labor is encouraged.
  2. External sources may be used, but must be properly cited; unprocessed or directly copied content is not allowed.
  3. All group members are expected to understand the presentation content and be able to respond to related questions.
  4. If specific roles are assigned (e.g., data collection, slide design), they should be briefly indicated in the presentation.
3. General Principles
  1. Discussion among students is encouraged; however, all individually submitted work must be completed independently.
  2. Students may not submit others’ work (including that of classmates, online sources, or AI-generated content) as their own.
  3. All submitted work is considered the student’s own and they are responsible for its content.
Violations of academic integrity may result in a zero grade for the assignment. Serious or repeated offenses will be handled in accordance with university regulations.
If students encounter difficulties in the learning process, they are encouraged to contact the instructor for guidance and appropriate academic support.

This course emphasizes students’ understanding of knowledge and their ability to express ideas independently. It also highlights the importance of integrity and responsibility throughout the learning process.
Assessment in this course includes monthly worksheets (individual assignments) and group presentations (including presentation slides). The following principles of academic integrity apply:
1. Individual Worksheets (to be completed independently)
  1. Worksheets must be completed by students independently and presented in their own words.
  2. Students may consult course materials, books, online resources, or generative AI tools; however, direct copying or superficial modification is not permitted.
  3. When using external sources (including AI-generated content), proper citation must be provided.
  4. Students should be able to explain their understanding and reasoning behind their responses.
2. Group Presentations (collaborative work)
  1. Group presentations and slides (PPT) may be prepared collaboratively, and division of labor is encouraged.
  2. External sources may be used, but must be properly cited; unprocessed or directly copied content is not allowed.
  3. All group members are expected to understand the presentation content and be able to respond to related questions.
  4. If specific roles are assigned (e.g., data collection, slide design), they should be briefly indicated in the presentation.
3. General Principles
  1. Discussion among students is encouraged; however, all individually submitted work must be completed independently.
  2. Students may not submit others’ work (including that of classmates, online sources, or AI-generated content) as their own.
  3. All submitted work is considered the student’s own and they are responsible for its content.
Violations of academic integrity may result in a zero grade for the assignment. Serious or repeated offenses will be handled in accordance with university regulations.
If students encounter difficulties in the learning process, they are encouraged to contact the instructor for guidance and appropriate academic support.

policy.course_pol:
本課程以建立良好學習環境為目標，期望師生之間以及同學彼此，皆以尊重、理性與專業的方式進行互動。課堂鼓勵多元觀點與討論，但須在彼此尊重的前提下進行。

一、基本課堂行為

請準時出席並做好上課準備，避免遲到或提早離開影響課程進行。
上課期間請避免聊天、使用手機或從事與課程無關之活動，以免干擾他人學習。
當同學發言或進行報告時，應專心聆聽並給予基本尊重。
鼓勵參與討論並表達不同觀點，但應以理性、適當的方式進行。

二、課堂設備與使用規範

筆記型電腦或平板僅限於課程相關用途（如記錄筆記、查閱資料）。
行動裝置請設定為靜音，避免來電或通知影響課堂。

三、分組與互動原則

分組活動中應積極參與，並尊重組員意見。
討論與交流應以促進理解為目的，避免干擾其他同學學習。

四、課程溝通與基本禮儀

與教師或同學聯繫時，應使用適當語氣並清楚表達內容。
課程相關資訊將透過學校系統公告，請同學定期查閱並掌握最新訊息。

五、學生學習責任

學生應主動掌握課程進度，並妥善安排學習時間。
請依規定完成期中「形成性教學評估」及期末「學生意見調查」，以協助課程改進。

本規則之目的在於維持良好學習環境，而非限制學生表達。只要不影響他人學習並保持基本尊重，課堂將保持彈性與開放。
policy.course_pol_en:
This course aims to foster a positive learning environment. Students and the instructor are expected to interact with one another in a respectful, rational, and professional manner. Diverse perspectives and open discussion are encouraged, provided that mutual respect is maintained.

1. Basic Classroom Behavior
Students are expected to attend class on time and be prepared. Late arrival or early departure should be avoided as it may disrupt the class.
During class, students should refrain from chatting, using mobile phones, or engaging in activities unrelated to the course, so as not to disrupt others’ learning.
When others are speaking or presenting, students should listen attentively and show respect.
Participation in discussion and the expression of different viewpoints are encouraged, but should be conducted in a respectful and appropriate manner.
2. Use of Devices
Laptops and tablets may be used for course-related purposes only (e.g., note-taking, accessing materials).
Mobile devices should be set to silent mode to avoid interruptions during class.
3. Group Work and Interaction
Students are expected to participate actively in group activities and respect the opinions of group members.
Discussions should aim to enhance understanding and should not interfere with other students’ learning.
4. Communication and Etiquette
When communicating with the instructor or classmates, students should use appropriate language and express themselves clearly.
Course-related information will be announced through the university system; students are responsible for checking updates regularly.
5. Student Responsibilities
Students are expected to keep up with the course schedule and manage their learning time effectively.
Students should complete the midterm formative evaluation and the end-of-semester course survey as required, as these are important for course improvement.

The purpose of these guidelines is to maintain an effective learning environment rather than to restrict expression. As long as students respect others and do not disrupt the class, the learning environment will remain flexible and open.
policy.course_rem:
多元與包容
本課程致力於營造多元、包容與尊重的學習環境。歡迎同學在課堂中適時表達個人觀點，並以理性與尊重的態度面對不同意見。不同背景與想法，將有助於深化我們對課程內容的理解。如有任何疑慮，歡迎與我討論。

學習方式與建議
本課程重視對內容的理解與整理，而非單純記憶。建議同學在課後適度回顧課堂內容，並透過學習單將所學轉化為自己的表達。與其追求標準答案，更重要的是建立清楚且有邏輯的理解與說明能力。適當閱讀相關資料並進行整理與反思，將有助於提升學習成效。

課程溝通方式
如對課程內容或作業有疑問，請以電子郵件與我聯繫。來信時請清楚說明問題內容，以利回覆與討論。我將於合理時間內回覆課程相關問題，並視需要提供進一步說明。

學習支持
我重視每位同學的學習進展。若在學習過程中遇到困難，建議及早與我聯繫，我將協助釐清問題或提供適當建議，以支持您完成本課程的學習。

本課程期待在良好溝通與互相尊重的基礎上，建立穩定而有效的學習節奏。
policy.course_rem_en:
Diversity and Inclusion

This course is committed to fostering a learning environment that values diversity, inclusion, and mutual respect. Students are encouraged to express their perspectives appropriately in class and to engage with differing viewpoints in a rational and respectful manner. Diverse backgrounds and ideas contribute to a deeper understanding of the course content. If you have any concerns, you are welcome to discuss them with the instructor.

Learning Approach and Suggestions

This course emphasizes understanding and organization of knowledge rather than rote memorization. Students are encouraged to review course materials after class and to use worksheets to transform what they have learned into their own expressions. Rather than seeking standard answers, the goal is to develop clear and logically structured understanding and explanation. Reading relevant materials and engaging in reflection will further enhance learning outcomes.

Course Communication

If you have questions regarding course content or assignments, please contact the instructor via email. When writing, clearly describe your questions to facilitate effective communication. The instructor will respond within a reasonable timeframe and provide further clarification when necessary.

Learning Support

The instructor values each student’s learning progress. If you encounter difficulties during the course, you are encouraged to reach out early. The instructor will assist in clarifying issues and provide appropriate guidance to support your learning.

This course aims to establish a steady and effective learning rhythm through clear communication and mutual respect.
policy.ais_meno:
本課程重視學生對知識的理解與個人表達，並強調在學習過程中建立誠信與責任意識。
本課程之評量包含每月學習單（個人作業）與分組報告（含簡報製作），相關學術誠信原則如下：
一、個人學習單（個別完成）
  1. 學習單須由學生自行完成，並以自身語言整理與表達學習內容。
  2. 可參考課堂內容、書籍、網路資料或生成式AI工具，但不得直接複製貼上或僅做表面修改。
  3. 使用外部資料（含AI生成內容）時，應適當標示來源。
  4. 學生須能說明其作答內容之理解與思考過程。
二、分組報告（合作完成）
  1. 分組報告與簡報（PPT）可由組員共同討論與製作，鼓勵分工合作。
  2. 簡報內容可參考外部資料，但須標示來源，不得直接挪用未經處理之內容。
  3. 各組成員應參與報告內容之理解與準備，並能回應相關提問。
  4. 若有明確分工（如資料整理、簡報設計等），建議於報告中簡要說明。
三、共同原則
  1. 鼓勵同學之間進行討論，但所有個人繳交之作業須獨立完成。
  2. 不得將他人作品（含同學、網路資料或AI生成內容）直接作為本人作品提交。
  3. 所有提交內容均視為學生本人之學習成果，並須對其內容負責。
違反學術誠信原則者，該次作業將視情況不予計分；情節重大或屢犯者，將依學校相關規定處理。
如在學習過程中遇到困難，建議主動與教師聯繫，以尋求協助與適當的學習支持。

courseBankC.describe_ch: 了解何謂「歷史」，思考歷史與今日的關係。
courseBankC.describe_en: To understand what is history, and the relationship between history and today
courseBankC.core_item: 知識探索：能培養多元領域學習的興趣；能統整跨領域的知識；能持續從事跨領域的學習。
courseBankC.core_eng: Knowledge Pursuit：To integrate extensive interests, curiosities and literacy of multidisciplinary knowledge and internalize one’s won viewpoints.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 分析歷史人物的成敗得失並應用到學生自身。
courseBankC.describe_en: To analyze the success and failures of historical figures and apply them to our own lives.
courseBankC.core_item: 批判思考：能跳脫框架、從不同角度看問題、並能客觀分析不同觀點的利弊得失、能理性評估後做出客觀判斷。
courseBankC.core_eng: Critical Thinking: Ability to jump out of the framework, look at issues from different angles, objectively analyze the pros and cons of different viewpoints, and make objective judgments after rational evaluation.
